question: There was a cloud policy circular a couple of years ago, something about migration. Which GR?
gold_answer: The cloud policy of 29-01-2018 (not recent), plus its later changes; latest is 23-04-2021

product.answer: I couldn't find a GR matching a specific date described as "a couple of years ago" in the question among the given texts, but the corpus contains several cloud policy circulars on migration. The 19-06-2019 GR (GAD-IT-060/3/2017) titled "Cloud Computing Policy- Instructions to Departments regarding hosting of IT applications" explicitly instructs that existing applications not hosted in a cloud environment must be migrated to cloud on or before 31.03.2020. The 29-01-2018 GR (060/3/2017) similarly mandates migration by 30.10.2018, while the 05-07-2019 GR adds instructions on defining data to be migrated and confirming archived data with the CSP.

product.answer: The GR dated 19-06-2019 (201906191741481211), which is an addendum to GAD-IT-060/3/2017, extended the cloud migration deadline for existing applications to 31-03-2020 and made security audits mandatory before going live. It was later superseded for procurement by the GR dated 23-04-2021 (202104231756150811), which moved all cloud service purchasing to the GeM portal after 30-04-2021. Earlier, the GR dated 16-05-2018 (201805171357566211) had set the initial migration deadline of 30-10-2018.
